tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file inside the workspace.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or fully overwrite one. For small changes use edit_file instead.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace one exact piece of text in a file. 'find' must match exactly and only once.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Rename or move a file inside the workspace.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete one file inside the workspace.

tools.name: delete_dir
tools.description: Permanently delete a folder and everything inside it, inside the workspace.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List files and folders in a workspace folder. Use '.' for the root.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find files by name anywhere in the workspace. Supports wildcards like '*.py'.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Find which files contain some text. Returns file, line number and the line.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command in the workspace. Returns output and exit code.

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Stop a running process by its exact name or its process id.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open an installed application on the user's computer by its name, e.g. 'Safari'. Not for files or paths.

tools.name: system_info
tools.description: Get OS, CPU, RAM and disk information about this computer.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web. Returns the top 5 results with titles, links and snippets.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Download a web page and return its readable text (read-only GET).

tools.name: http_request
tools.description: Make an HTTP request to a URL. Can POST/PUT/DELETE, so it can change things on the server.

tools.name: show_images
tools.description: Search the web for pictures and put them on the user's screen.

tools.name: show_list
tools.description: Put a list on the user's screen. Use it when they ask for a list. Each item has a short title and a one-line detail. Only real items you know or got from a tool.

tools.name: show_chart
tools.description: Put a chart on the user's screen. labels and values must be the same length. kind is 'bar' to compare things or 'line' for change over time. Only real numbers.

tools.name: about_me
tools.description: Get full details about yourself: your model, settings, every tool and its state, memory count and limits. Use this when the user asks what you can do.
